description: This PHP source file contains a library of functions for generating HTML documents, including requirements, test cases, test plans, and related entities for the TestLink project. It includes functions for rendering various test artifacts into HTML format, handling attachments, custom fields, object relations, and document structure such as table of contents and headers.

classes.name: tlUser
classes.description: Class representing a user, used for fetching author display names.

classes.name: testcase
classes.description: Class for test case management, used for fetching test case data.

classes.name: tree
classes.description: Generic tree structure handler used for nodes and relations.

classes.name: requirement_mgr
classes.description: Requirement manager class handling requirements and specifications.

classes.name: testplan
classes.description: Test plan class used for handling test plans and associated data.

methods.name: renderHTMLHeader
methods.description: Generates the HTML header for documents, including CSS, JS, and meta tags.

methods.name: renderFirstPage
methods.description: Generates the initial page of a document with title, author, test project, plan, build, and legal notices.

methods.name: renderSimpleChapter
methods.description: Creates a simple HTML chapter with a title and content.

methods.name: renderTOC
methods.description: Generates the Table of Contents section for the document.

methods.name: renderTestSpecTreeForPrinting
methods.description: Recursively renders a test specification tree into HTML for printing.

methods.name: renderTestCaseForPrinting
methods.description: Renders a detailed test case into HTML for printing, including steps, attachments, and relations.

methods.name: renderReqForPrinting
methods.description: Renders a requirement as HTML for printing.

methods.name: renderReqSpecNodeForPrinting
methods.description: Renders a requirement specification node as HTML for printing.

methods.name: renderReqSpecTreeForPrinting
methods.description: Recursively renders a complete requirement specification tree into HTML for printing.

methods.name: renderTestPlanForPrinting
methods.description: Renders a test plan node and its subtree into HTML for printing.

methods.name: renderTestDuration
methods.description: Generates HTML showing estimated and real execution durations.

methods.name: renderEOF
methods.description: Returns the closing HTML tags for the document.

methods.name: buildTestPlanMetrics
methods.description: Builds HTML metrics summaries (e.g., execution time) for test plans.

methods.name: initRenderTestCaseCfg
methods.description: Initializes configuration for rendering test cases, such as labels and style options.

methods.name: gendocGetUserName
methods.description: Returns a display name for a user ID, utilizing session caching.

methods.name: getAttachmentInfos
methods.description: Retrieves attachment information for test objects, including images and files.

methods.name: renderPlatformHeading
methods.description: Render HTML header for a platform section with optional notes and anchor links.

methods.name: prefixToHTMLID
methods.description: Utility function to generate HTML-safe anchor IDs from strings, with prefixing.

methods.name: renderTestProjectItem
methods.description: Render a test project item as an HTML chapter with links.

methods.name: renderTestPlanItem
methods.description: Render a test plan item as an HTML chapter with links.

methods.name: renderExecutionForPrinting
methods.description: Render detailed execution report for a given execution ID, including test case details and associated information.

methods.name: renderBuildItem
methods.description: Render a build information block as an HTML chapter.

methods.name: initStaticRenderTestCaseForPrinting
methods.description: Prepare environment and utility objects for rendering a test case statically for printing.
